bricks.label: struct Node
bricks.plain_english: Defines a tree node — stores an int value, a left pointer, and a right pointer. BST needs left and right, not next.
bricks.scene_description: A single root sphere appears in the centre of the scene.

bricks.label: createNode()
bricks.plain_english: Allocates a tree node, sets its value, and sets left and right to NULL.
bricks.scene_description: Value label appears on the sphere. Two NULL placeholder dots appear below it.

bricks.label: insert()
bricks.plain_english: BST insert — walks left if the value is smaller than current, right if larger. Recurses until it finds a NULL spot and places the new node there.

bricks.label: search()
bricks.plain_english: Walks the BST path — left if target is smaller, right if larger — until found or NULL reached.

bricks.label: inorder()
bricks.plain_english: Left → Root → Right traversal. Visits nodes in sorted order for a valid BST.
bricks.scene_description: Nodes light up in sorted order from left to right.

bricks.label: preorder()
bricks.plain_english: Root → Left → Right traversal. The root lights first, then left subtree, then right.
bricks.scene_description: Root lights first, then the left subtree, then the right.

bricks.label: postorder()
bricks.plain_english: Left → Right → Root traversal. Used for safe deletion — children are processed before their parent.
bricks.scene_description: Leaf nodes light first, then their parents, and the root lights last.

bricks.label: deleteNode()
bricks.plain_english: Removes a node from the BST. Handles three cases: leaf (just remove), one child (rewire), two children (replace with inorder successor).

bricks.label: height()
bricks.plain_english: Recursively counts the longest path from a node to a leaf. Returns 0 for NULL.
bricks.scene_description: Depth level labels appear beside each node.
